blurb: The Coronado Golf Course is a par 72, 6,590-yard course with immaculate greens and wide fairways, open year-round. It offers beautiful views of San Diego harbor and downtown. Tee times can be reserved up to 14 days in advance, with walk-ons welcome.
extraNote: Tee times may be reserved up to 14 days in advance · Reservations 3-14 days out can be booked online with a $25 non-refundable fee per player · Reservations must be canceled at least 24 hours prior to day of play or full fees charged · Players must check in 20 minutes before tee time or risk cancellation · Walk-ons are welcome and may join waiting list on day of play
